src/screens/LibraryScreen.tsx.description: Added empty search results state handling in both renderContent() (lines 915-951) and renderTraktContent() (lines 815-843). Differentiates between empty library and empty search results using the debouncedSearchQuery state. Shows 'search-off' icon, 'No results found' title, and includes the search query in the message. Includes a 'Clear search' button to reset the search.
